product_metadata.title: BELLA (13683) Personal Espresso Maker with Steam Wand, Glass Decanter & Permanent Filter, Black
features: Please refer to user guide or user manual or user guide (provided below in PDF) before first use
description: Be your own barista with the BELLA personal Espresso Maker! This compact personal sized espresso machine will have you saying "latte" in no time. Equipped with 5 bars of constant pressure this little guy puts out a bold, crema filled espresso shot in seconds. The built in milk frother / steam wand will stretch your creative barista mind giving you the option to make your very own latte, cappuccino, macchiato and more at home. Power Source - Corded electric
